displayName: OCI-PCI-009: PCI-DSS — Audit Log Tampering in CDE
description:
Detects tampering or disabling of audit logs in cardholder data environment

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: pci-dss — audit log tampering in cde

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_pci_009", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%pci%' AND "value" > 0
